oil.when: 2015 using the Driver Information Center buttons
steps: Reset only after the engine oil and filter have actually been changed.
With the ignition on, use the DIC buttons to bring up REMAINING OIL LIFE in the instrument cluster.
Press and hold the SEL button until the CHANGE ENGINE OIL SOON message clears and oil life shows 100%.
Reset only after the engine oil and filter have actually been changed.
Turn the ignition on with the engine off.
Push the accelerator pedal all the way down and let it up three times within five seconds.
If the CHANGE ENGINE OIL SOON message is gone, the reset worked. If it is still showing or returns at the next start, repeat the steps.
oil.note: Checked in the 2014 and 2015 owner's manuals.

oil.when: 2010 using the Vehicle Information and Set/Reset buttons
steps: Reset only after the engine oil and filter have actually been changed.
Turn the ignition on without starting the engine.
Press the Vehicle Information button until OIL LIFE REMAINING shows on the Driver Information Center.
Press and hold the Set/Reset button until the reading shows 100%.
Turn the ignition off.
oil.note: Checked in the 2010 CTS convenience and personalization guide.

oil.when: 2004 with the standard radio (DIC buttons beside the display)
steps: Reset only after the engine oil and filter have actually been changed.
With the ignition on, press CLR next to the Driver Information Center display to clear the change engine oil message.
Use the up or down arrow on the INFO button to scroll the DIC menu to the engine oil life percentage.
With the oil life item highlighted, press and hold CLR until it reads 100%.
Turn the key off. If the reading did not return to 100% or the message comes back at the next start, repeat the steps.
Reset only after the engine oil and filter have actually been changed.
With the ignition on, press the screen-side button next to the OK prompt to clear the change engine oil message.
Turn the system on with the PWR/VOL knob and press INFO.
Turn the TUNE/SEL knob to highlight Engine Oil Life and press the knob.
Press the button next to the Reset prompt, then turn the key off. If the message comes back at the next start, repeat the steps.

tpms.when: 2015 after the low tire pressure light came on
steps: Set all four tires to the cold pressure on the Tire and Loading Information label in the driver's door opening.
There is no reset button: the low tire pressure light stays on until the pressures are corrected, then goes out.
Check that the light has gone out. If it stays on, recheck all four tires with a gauge and have the system checked if they are correct.
tpms.note: Checked in the 2015 owner's manual. The light can come on at the first start on a cold morning and go out as you drive; that is an early sign the tires need air. If the light flashes for about a minute and then stays on, the system has a fault that inflating the tires will not clear.

notes: The oil life system does not reset itself after an oil change, so reset it every time, and only after the oil has actually been changed.
